answer: Require every agent to register one onyx credential before earning: its nullifier goes into a public registry, and a second registration with the same credential is provably a duplicate, so that identity is frozen on sight. Each registration carries a verifiable signal of origin — funding source and attestation history — and any vine sharing one funding source is capped at one paid identity, with a third duplicate freezing the whole cluster. A faker pays 400 tokens locked 60 days per identity, 100% slashed on duplication, so 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens upfront.
